faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Customer Service Executive (CSE) - IBL & HL posts is 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline (10+2+3) to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the CSE post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years of experience in sourcing, processing, and servicing Business Loans and Affordable Housing Loans is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the NABFINS CSE recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email with complete bio-data and required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What are the locations for the CSE posts?
faq.answer: The vacancies are available for Madhya Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q7. Is local language knowledge mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of the local language is mandatory for the Customer Service Executive role.

faq.question: Q8. Does NABFINS offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data; please refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Customer Service Executive (CSE) - IBL & HL posts is Full Time.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
